scientific_integrity: Proof uses analytic estimates and an identified published Toeplitz characterization; no independent validation or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The nonproximinality and phase-complexity conclusions are proved only for continuous-symbol absolutely minimum-attaining Toeplitz approximants. The distance equality also covers arbitrary absolutely minimum-attaining Toeplitz approximants. Possible equivalent results in unindexed scalar phase-approximation literature are a residual originality risk.
title: Smooth phase-chirp obstruction and sharp phase-variation cost in Toeplitz minimum-attainment approximation
